annotation.title_clean: 事业单位登记管理条例
annotation.title_en: Regulations on the Registration and Administration of Public Institutions
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 中华人民共和国国务院 (State Council of the PRC)
annotation.summary_en: State Council Order No. 849 promulgating the Regulations on Registration and Administration of Public Institutions (shiye danwei), effective 1 December 2026. It sets Party leadership, registration, supervision, information disclosure and legal liability rules for public institutions, replacing the interim regulations. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Public institutions must register to obtain legal-person status and a certificate
Strengthens Communist Party leadership within public institutions
Negative-list management, credit management and abnormal-list for institutions
Annual reports and public disclosure via a national platform
Penalties include warnings, suspension and revocation of certificates; replaces the interim regulations on 1 Dec 2026
